items.html: And likewise Arich purified for the Nukva of Aba and Ima, and Aba and Ima for the need of ZON, the entire phase of Malchut that is in them, for this is why these are called kings, since from them all the kingships were made. And likewise in all the ten Sefirot themselves of every single Partzuf, their purification was in the order mentioned, and what could not be purified and rise into the world of Atzilut, even to the lower Nukva of ZA, remained in Beria, and from them afterward were made all the parts of Beria, in the order of its degrees. And the sparks of Beria cannot be purified by Aba and Ima of Atzilut, since they cannot rise above ZON; rather, they are purified in the belly of the Nukva of ZA, through the coupling of ZA with her.
